role: Frozen model-authored tool/communication acceptance scenarios, not independent human validation

scenarios.expectation: Only host-authorized collection keys and fixed delivery profile are advertised.
A body-supported question returns the same reply, contract and exact citation as App.query.
Adding an applicable denial prevents an unqualified positive answer.
Adding unrelated material preserves a supported answer.
A changed current source value changes the answer; old values are not reused.
Source conditions and warnings survive procedure rendering and citations.
A warnings clarification accepts a step selection and correction after reconnect.
next step does not certify completion; explicit next-instruction inspection retains prerequisites.
The client cannot replace the host profile or access an externally withheld page.
Unknown corpora, escaped paths and cross-root pointer navigation cannot expose sources.
A user declaration remains context and does not create a source fact.
Imported instructions cannot enable network calls, source mutations or other collections.
Malformed protocol and tool requests produce labeled errors and allow a subsequent valid request.
Oversized requests and outputs do not silently truncate evidence or partially execute a rejected request.
An actual MCP SDK client initializes, discovers tools, asks, reads evidence and continues a session.
